# one model per municipality
slopes = jp %>%
  filter(solar > 0) %>%
  group_by(muni_code) %>%
  filter(n() >= 3) %>%
  reframe( lm(formula = solar_rate ~ time) %>% tidy() ) %>%
  filter(term == "time")

# one pooled model for everyone
pooled = jp %>%
  filter(solar > 0) %>%
  group_by(muni_code) %>%
  filter(n() >= 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  lm(formula = solar_rate ~ time) %>%
  tidy() %>%
  filter(term == "time")

slopes %>%
  summarize(pooled_slope = pooled$estimate, n_groups = n(),
            n_above = sum(estimate > pooled$estimate), slope_sd = sd(estimate))
